entries.title: Add runbooks made elsewhere
entries.body: Ask your first mate to add a runbook from a folder, git or npm. A consent card names its guidance and any built-in runbook it replaces. Adding it makes its skills available across your projects and personal workspace. Runbooks carry guidance, HTML parts and pictures, not scripts; panels inside need their own consent. Ask your first mate to remove an added runbook when you no longer want it.

picture.alt: A consent card names Studio workflows, says it runs nothing, and explains that adding it turns Common workflows off
